{{Top|leg}}
The '''Wookiee Network''' was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] network established by members of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to resist the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was run out of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and worked with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it fed information to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Chenlambec]] that enabled him [[Mission to Lomabu III|to free]] Wookiees from an Imperial prison on [[Lomabu III]].
